item.title: JTA back to negotiating table this morning as it seeks answers on salary concerns
item.description: The JTA, as well as the Finance and Education Ministries, have long been engaged in discussions over proper compensation for the nation's teachers. This as the JTA maintains that the wage package must reflect value for educators. item.title: Subsea fibre optic cable to be operational by third quarter next year
item.description: Yesterday, the government signed a letter of intent with Trans Americas Fiber system for the subsea cable project, which aims to strengthen the country’s digital infrastructure. Telecommunications Minister Daryl Vaz noted that the final agreement is expected to be signed later this year, with construction of the cable anticipated for the fourth quarter of 2026. item.title: Agriculture Minister Floyd Green commits $30M to support egg farming at CASE
item.description: According to the ministry, this is to help drive the resuscitation of the egg industry following hurricane Melissa. Speaking at a founders’ weekend event at the institution recently, the minister said that the funds are to be used to rebuild the hatchery and build a pullet house, for Jamaica to produce more layers.
